profile_text.body:
UiPath is a publicly traded enterprise software company (NYSE: PATH, CIK 0001734722) that describes itself as providing a platform for business orchestration and automation. Its core offering, the UiPath Platform, is positioned around combining AI agents, robotic process automation, and human workers to handle enterprise workflows at scale. The company markets capabilities across document understanding, process mining, and automation governance, and it targets industries including insurance, government, finance, and advertising.

The company's site highlights several customer outcomes attributed to its platform. Johnson Controls is cited as saving $18 million and 900,000 hours by automating invoice processing across 6,500 daily invoices. Uber is described as on pace to save $22 million through automation, and VITAL is said to have served 450% more agencies while saving 15,000 work hours. Dentsu, a global advertising agency, is reported to be saving more than 125,000 hours using UiPath automation. Other named customers include TQL, Generali, and Xerox.

The held facts record UiPath's primary tracked product as UiPath AI, categorized under automation and agents, encompassing its RPA and AI platform along with document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance capabilities. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts at this time.
